packageRules.description: CI refuses a tree where .bun-version and the Dockerfile's base images differ, so they move in one PR
The code reads internals of these (Yjs structs, y-codemirror decorations) or pairs them with a pinned sysroot, so a bump waits for a person even when CI is green
The tests fake the Anthropic API, so CI cannot tell whether a new SDK still sends a request the real API accepts; a person sends one real request first
